The Fraud Agent then took over, performing a Fraud & Identity Analysis and detecting potential identity mismatches in both the PAN and Aadhaar verification results. This analysis led to the system's decision to auto-reject the application due to KYC failure.

Key autonomous behaviors exhibited by the system include the Data Agent's dynamic tool selection and adaptation to the application's profile, as well as the Fraud Agent's ability to analyze and detect potential identity fraud. There were no edge case fallback rules triggered in this process, and the system's decision was reached through a series of logical and autonomous behaviors exhibited by the agents.
